findings.mechanism: Plan mobileColumns is name/structure/current; results is name/annual/delta. DataTable maps other cells to hidden md:table-cell, expandable defaults false, neither call supplies mobilePresentation/renderExpanded. No mobile equivalent is declared.

findings.title: Annual-cost chart hardcodes two minor digits
findings.mechanism: chartData and chartTableRows divide annual_cost_minor by100, while formatCurrencyMinor derives ISO digits and divides by10**digits. Chart and accessible table disagree with ranked money for permitted JPY/KWD currencies; chart labels omit denomination.

steps: Synthetic same-currency JPY12345 -> chart123.45 versus money12345 JPY.
Synthetic KWD12345 -> chart123.45 versus money12.345. Arithmetic source walkthrough only.

findings.fix: Use existing currency denomination owner and label axis/tooltip/table; retain raw minor units, no invented FX.

findings.title: 1440 end-of-day is passed as invalid native time24:00
findings.mechanism: newRate.end_minute=1440; minutesToClock clamps inclusively and formats24:00. Native time accepts hours00-23. clockToMinutes("00:00") returns0, not1440. Field is not required, so default save blockage is NOT established.

steps: Follow1440 -> hours24/minutes00 -> input type=time value24:00.
00:00 edits back to0. Native sanitization/display/keyboard NOTRUN.

findings.fix: Expose valid end-of-day representation round-tripping1440; preserve business interval, not workspace UTC conversion.

steps: Synthetic total101/limit100/offset0 response: there is no path requesting offset100; record101 has no toggle/remove.

findings.title: Four dependent replay sections omit publication.source
findings.mechanism: Chart/economics/occupancy/evidence receive retained values without source. OwnershipPanel with absent source resolves ready/empty. Only summary brief declares replay trust; controls error alone cannot explain paused state.

steps: Consider retained success then pending/error/paused replay.

findings.fix: Thread real publication.source/enablement through existing adapters; preserve retained data and independent library.

findings.title: Initial paused replay labelled Loading source
findings.mechanism: Retained mutation sets isLoading=pending without publication and fetchStatus=paused. deriveDataState exposes isRefreshBlocked. Brief ignores it, selects Loading source and loading=true; summary OwnershipPanel itself has no source to compensate.

steps: Synthetic data undefined/error null/isPending true/isPaused true/matching vehicle -> isLoading true/isFetching false/fetchStatus paused.
Brief says Loading source/busy without initial-pause explanation. Offline action NOTRUN.

findings.fix: Use existing isRefreshBlocked distinction; do not imply cached data, empty response, active fetch or fatal server failure.

findings.title: Recorded bounds/evidence dates bypass effective preferences
findings.mechanism: Brief/EvidencePanel import pure formatDateTime with no options. Pure helper uses browser locale/timezone; existing useDateFormat supplies settings locale/timezone. Eight calls on six lines bypass differing saved preferences.

steps: Synthetic UTC instant near midnight plus saved timezone/locale different from browser: all eight calls follow host defaults.
No preferences changed or formatter tests executed.

findings.fix: One shared domain root adopts existing date hook in both adapters; retain raw instants/unknowns/business minutes.

findings.title: Three generated tariff labels bypass i18n

steps: Non-English locale still takes all three untranslated paths.

findings.fix: Translate display enum/new defaults only; retain raw enums and existing user labels; parent serializes catalog needs.

findings.title: Quality badge renders closed English status raw

steps: Synthetic limited quality under non-English locale still renders limited; no t() lookup.

findings.fix: Reuse localized closed-status labels with unchanged tones/unknown behavior.

findings.title: Deleted/disappeared selected IDs persist in next replay
findings.mechanism: Selection changes only via toggleSelected. Delete success invalidates query but does not clean local selected. A disappeared selected row loses its toggle; no clear-selection action exists. Run forwards selected unchanged.

steps: Source walkthrough select ID2 then successful deletion/refetch omitting2 -> selected remains[2].
Next Run submits tariff_ids:[2]; backend rejection/ignore unknown, no deletion run.

findings.fix: Remove success-confirmed deleted IDs and offer truthful clear/reconciliation; do not clear selections merely because partial page unloaded.

findings.title: Returned zero shift saving appears unavailable

steps: Synthetic load_shift_saving_minor0 takes em-dash branch.
